name: SQLite-to-PGlite Migration Tool
description: Build the migration tool: extract from SQLite, transform, load into PGlite. Idempotent, resumable, with progress reporting.
purpose: Migration is a tool, not a script.
acceptanceCriteria: Migration tool extracts all data from SQLite with schema-aware queries
Data is transformed to match PGlite column types and constraints
Loading is resumable from the last checkpoint on interruption
Progress reporting shows rows migrated, remaining, and ETA
Tool is idempotent — running twice produces same PGlite state
Tool exits with non-zero on any unrecoverable error
